apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: orders-view-app
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: orders-view-app
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: orders-view-app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: orders-view-app
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 2000
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - labelSelector:
              matchExpressions:
              - key: app
                operator: In
                values:
                - orders-view-app
            topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      volumes:
      - name: spring-boot-application-properties
        secret:
          secretName: spring-boot-application-properties
      - name: rocksdb
        emptyDir: {}
      containers:
      - name: orders-view-app
        image: docker.io/gamussa/livestreams-orders-view-app:stable
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /mnt/app
          name: spring-boot-application-properties
        - mountPath: /mnt/kafka-streams-store/
          name: rocksdb
        env:
        - name: SPRING_CONFIG_LOCATION
          value: /mnt/app/application.properties
        - name: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS
          value: -DLOGLEVEL=INFO
        securityContext:
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          privileged: false
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi

apiVersion: apps/v1

  name: titan-ccp-load-generator

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: titan-ccp-load-generator
  replicas: 1

      labels:
        app: titan-ccp-load-generator

        - name: ZK_PORT

        - name: KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS

        - name: SCHEMA_REGISTRY_URL
          value: http://my-confluent-cp-schema-registry:8081
        - name: POD_NAME

            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.name

          capabilities:
            drop:

apiVersion: apps/v1

metadata:
  name: openvpn-server
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: openvpn-server
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: openvpn-server
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: openvpn-server
        image: quay.io/sjenning/poc:openvpn

        command:

            drop:
            - ALL

            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /etc/openvpn/server
          name: server
        - mountPath: /etc/openvpn/ccd
          name: ccd
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
      volumes:
      - secret:
          secretName: openvpn-server
        name: server
      - secret:
          secretName: openvpn-ccd
